# RAPPORT DE NON-CONFORMITE (RNC)

Forges Martelliere S.A. - Corps de valve forge TA6V ref. FDB-AV3-001

## 1 — Identification de la Non-Conformite

Numero RNC : RNC-FB-2024-007 Fournisseur : Forges Martelliere S.A. Produit : Corps de valve forge TA6V ref. FDB-AV3-001 Lot : Lot FB-2024-0156 Detecte par : Controle reception Toulouse (QC-TLS-0042, Mme Leclerc) Date de detection : 15/07/2024

## 2 — Description de la Non-Conformite

Non-conformite dimensionnelle recurrente sur pieces forgees en titane TA6V. Ecart sur la cote de diametre exterieur : mesure 64,82 mm pour tolerance 65,00 +/- 0,10 mm (hors tolerance basse de 0,08 mm). 8 pieces sur 50 affectees (16% du lot).

## 3 — Analyse des Causes

Usure des matrices de forge non detectee lors du controle periodique. Le plan de maintenance preventive du fournisseur prevoit un controle des matrices toutes les 500 pieces, insuffisant pour le titane TA6V.

## 4 — Disposition

Lot refuse. 42 pieces conformes acceptees apres tri. 8 pieces non conformes retournees au fournisseur pour reprise.

## 5 — Action Corrective Requise

Le fournisseur doit soumettre un plan d'actions correctives sous 15 jours ouvrables.

Le Fournisseur s'engage à souscrire et maintenir pendant toute la duree du contrat une assurance responsabilité civile professionnelle d'un montant minimum de cinq millions d'euros (5 000 000 EUR) par sinistre et par an, et a en justifier sur simple demande du Client.

Le certificat matière 3.1 selon EN 10204 a été verifie et les proprietes mecaniques (Rm, Rp0.2, A%, durete) sont conformes aux exigences de la specification materiau AMS 4928 pour l'alliage de titane Ti-6Al-4V.

Le contentieux a ete inscrit au registre des risques juridiques du groupe sous la reference RJ-2024-XXX. Son suivi est place sous la responsabilité directe du directeur juridique.

L'exercice de gestion de crise cyber realise au cours de l'exercice à implique 45 participants de 6 entites du groupe et à permis d'identifier des lacunes dans la coordination inter-entites et dans la communication externe en situation de crise.

Le Fournisseur s'engage à maintenir, pendant toute la duree du contrat, un système de management de la qualite certifie ISO 9001. En cas de perte de cette certification, le Client se reserve le droit de suspendre les commandes en cours.

--- Page 2 ---

La direction juridique recommande la designation d'un mediateur agree par le Centre de Mediation et d'Arbitrage de Paris (CMAP) afin de tenter une resolution amiable avant l'engagement d'une procedure judiciaire au fond.

L'ecart dimensionnel constate sur la cote du port B (mesure : 25,015 mm pour une tolerance de 25,000 +0,010/-0,000 mm) a fait l'objet d'une demande de concession technique aupres du bureau d'études (reference EC-2024-0089).

La verification de l'efficacité des actions correctives sera effectuee sur les trois prochains lots de production. Le CAPA sera clos apres confirmation de l'absence de recurrence sur un minimum de 150 pieces.

La directive NIS2 impose aux entites essentielles et importantes la mise en oeuvre de mesures de gestion des risques de cybersecurite, incluant la gestion des incidents, la continue d'activité, la securité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement et la gouvernance.

Le rapport d'audit fournisseur a identifie trois (3) non-conformites majeures relatives à la maitrise du processus de forgeage et au système de tracabilite des matieres premieres. Un plan d'actions correctives avec echeances a ete exige.

# NON-CONFORMITY REPORT (NCR)

Shanghai Xinhua Precision Machining Co. Ltd - Machined housing ref. SX-VRC-HOU-005

## 1 — Non-Conformity Identification

NCR Number: NCR-SX-2024-012 Supplier: Shanghai Xinhua Precision Machining Co. Ltd Product: Machined housing ref. SX-VRC-HOU-005 Lot: Lot SX-2024-0089 Detected by: Incoming Inspection (QC-TLS-0038, M. Girard) Detection date: 20/10/2024

## 2 — Non-Conformity Description

Discrepancy between material certificate and actual material composition. Certificate states AISI 316L stainless steel, but XRF analysis reveals molybdenum content of 1.8% (spec requires 2.0-3.0% for 316L). 25 pieces affected.

## 3 — Root Cause Analysis

Supplier used non-certified raw material from a secondary source. Traceability gap in supplier's incoming material inspection process.

## 4 — Disposition

Entire lot quarantined pending material re-analysis by independent laboratory. If confirmed non-compliant, full lot rejection and supplier corrective action.

## 5 — Corrective Action Required

Supplier to submit corrective action plan within 15 business days.

Part marking includes: lot number, part number, serial number, date of manufacture, and inspector stamp. Marking is performed by micro-percussion per customer specification.

Storage conditions for released parts conform to requirements: temperature 15-25 degrees C, relative humidity below 60%, protection from dust and mechanical shock. Maximum storage duration before dispatch is 90 days.

This Agreement may not be assigned, in whole or in part, by either Party without the prior written consent of the other Party. Any unauthorized assignment shall be void and of no effect.

It is recommended that no public statement be made regarding this matter, given the confidentiality obligations under the mediation clause and the potential for reputational harm.

In the event of late delivery, the Customer shall be entitled to liquidated damages of 0.5% of the relevant Purchase Order value per week of delay, capped at 10% of the total Purchase Order value.

Non-destructive testing by fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI) was carried out in accordance with NAS 410 / EN 4179 Level 2, by a certified NDT operator. No linear indications exceeding 1.5 mm were detected.

--- Page 2 ---

The batch record includes the following records: production traveller, test reports (leak, fatigue, functional, NDT), material certificates, calibration certificates, non-conformity reports where applicable, and EASA Form 1.

Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall first be subject to good faith negotiations for a period of thirty (30) days. If unresolved, either Party may refer the dispute to the competent courts as specified herein.

The fatigue test was conducted per ASTM E466 at ambient temperature (23 +/- 2 degrees C), with a stress ratio R = 0.1 and a cyclic frequency of 10 Hz. The specimen endured 10^7 cycles without visible crack initiation.

It is noted that any document filed in the proceedings may be subject to disclosure to the opposing party. Internal documents should be prepared accordingly.

Any amendment to this Agreement shall be in writing and duly executed by authorized representatives of both Parties. No oral modification or waiver shall be binding upon either Party.

Statistical process control (SPC) monitoring is in place for critical dimensions identified in control plan CP-AV3000-Rev.F. Process capability indices Cpk exceed 1.67 for all key characteristics.

Effectiveness verification of the corrective actions will be performed over the next three production lots. The CAPA will be closed after confirming no recurrence over a minimum of 150 parts.

The provision amount has been determined based on the best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the present obligation at the reporting date, taking into account the risks and uncertainties inherent in the matter.

Environmental conditions during functional testing were within specification: temperature 23 +/- 2 degrees C, relative humidity 45 +/- 10%, hydraulic fluid cleanliness class 6 per NAS 1638.

The Group's litigation history in comparable matters shows an amicable resolution rate of approximately 65%, with settlement amounts averaging 45% of the initial claim.

The applicable reference documentation for this lot is specification SP-AV3000-Rev.D dated 01/11/2019, together with control plan CP-AV3000-Rev.D and manufacturing routing MR-AV3000-Rev.D.

The manufacturing routing comprises 9 principal operations from material cutting (Op 10) to final inspection and release (Op 90). Each operation requires operator sign-off and quality verification.

The Supplier shall procure and maintain throughout the Term professional liability insurance with a minimum cover of five million euros (EUR 5,000,000) per occurrence and in the aggregate per year, and shall provide evidence thereof upon request.

The Supplier shall maintain ISO 9001 certification (and AS9100 or NADCAP where applicable) throughout the Term. Loss of certification shall constitute a material breach entitling the Customer to suspend Purchase Orders.

ambiguous_guidance: Use one supported artifact, test, checklist, or lot fact.
Pair it with one unresolved limitation about audit completeness, missing attachments, traceability, or certification coverage.
wrong_guidance: Mutate lot number, conformance status, missing artifact, test result, supplier, or certificate.
Do not leave any unsupported quality claim partially grounded.
